newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks close higher, confirm upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks close higher, confirm upward trend.

text.p: Tokyo stocks eked out only small gains by the end of Friday's session after a three-day winning streak.
But brokers said they were able to confirm the firmness in the market's current trend after stock prices won back the losses they had suffered this morning.
Since the market's key Nikkei average had shot up above its resistance level of 21,406, the next target -- a high of 22,666 -- was now within sight, they said.
The key 225-share Nikkei average rose 85.65 points or 0.40 percent to close at 21,547.02. But in the futures market, the key December futures were down 50 points to finish at 21,500.

Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's dissolution of the Lower House of parliament earlier in the day and his cabinet's formal announcement of a date of October 20 for general elections had been widely expected by market participants, brokers said.
They also said the political factor would not be a negative factor for the stock market, although participants did not expect stock prices to get a strong boost from this.
